position_outside: UN/LOCODE places Rouen on the city centre (49.45, 1.1), about 10 km upriver of the Grand-Couronne quays. A ship there is in the city, not at a terminal.

properties.source: Derived: the convex hull of this port's terminals from OpenStreetMap, grown by 250 m
properties.note: OpenStreetMap maps no port limits for Rouen. These are the hull of the Grand-Couronne terminals below, grown by 250 m, which takes in the width of the Seine along the quays. The centres of Grand-Couronne, Petit-Couronne, Grand-Quevilly, Val-de-la-Haye and Rouen are outside. On the far bank the 250 m takes in the riverside road at Val-de-la-Haye and Hautot-sur-Seine (Quai Napoléon) and a few houses there.

properties.name: Container terminal
properties.operator: SOMAP and Agence Maritime de Seine (AMS)
properties.note: One unnamed port area (industrial=port) along the Seine at Grand-Couronne. It holds HAROPA's Terminal conteneurs et marchandises diverses (TCMD), a 41 ha site with 1,150 m of quay for containers, ro-ro and general cargo, run by SOMAP (Marfret) and AMS (Kuhn) according to HAROPA's 2026 container terminal catalogue. The bulk berths with conveyors at its downstream end serve Saipol's oilseed plant.

properties.name: Saipol
properties.note: The Saipol (Avril group) rapeseed crushing and biodiesel plant, mapped as man_made=works. HAROPA lists a berth for its biodiesel and oils and handles its dry bulk through the Grand-Couronne terminal.

properties.name: Sea-Tank Rouen
properties.note: A liquid bulk terminal: 26 tanks for vegetable oils, biofuels, liquid fertilisers and chemicals, with two ship berths and one for barges, according to HAROPA. Mapped as landuse=industrial.
